title: The Healthcare Paradox — Official Trailer: Less Funding. Exceptional Performance.
description: What is The Healthcare Paradox? It's the podcast that explains how America's healthcare system really works — the money, the rules, and the results — in plain English. No jargon. No spin. Just real data and real federal policy. One example nobody in Washington can explain: Puerto Rico receives 41% less Medicare funding than the states — and yet it delivers some of the strongest Medicare Advantage quality results in the nation. Less funding. Exceptional performance.
